messages.author: aacc6b267809c4ca
messages.subject: _rows_all not showing all but only those that are the same as in _rows_current
parts: I am trying to use R package DT. It seems to work OK except that  _rows_all does not contain the indices for all rows, but only those in _rows_current.  _rows_selected and _rows_current seem to work fine. Any suggestion on what could be wrong?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372

parts:
I think you need the development version of DT: https://github.com/rstudio/DT

Regards,
Yihui

Thanks, Yihui!

I did a little more testing. It seems the following works fine 
 output$report = DT::renderDataTable(myReportData(), server = FALSE)
but not
output$report = DT::renderDataTable(myReportData(), server = TRUE)

But in your example at https://yihui.shinyapps.io/DT-info/ it works when server=TRUE

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: _rows_all not showing all but only those that are the same as in _rows_current
parts:
It is probably a firewall or proxy issue. Try this

install.packages(
"DT",
type = "source",
repos = c("http://yihui.name/xran", "http://cran.rstudio.com")
)

Regards,
Yihui
